# olivares_access_edges (Data Source)

Reads the R/RW access-edge map of the Olivares AI control plane, and optionally the permitted-vs-observed least-privilege diff (read-only). Requires accessgraph:read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the R/RW access map, and the reconciled permitted-vs-observed drift.
data "olivares_access_edges" "map" {
  include_drift = true
}

output "unexpected_accesses" {
  value = [for d in data.olivares_access_edges.map.drift : d if d.kind == "unexpected_access"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_drift` (Boolean) Also fetch the permitted-vs-observed least-privilege diff into `drift`. Defaults to false.
- `tenant` (String) Tenant UUID, overriding the provider-level tenant. Sent as X-Olivares-Tenant.

### Read-Only

- `drift` (Attributes List) The RECONCILED permitted-vs-observed least-privilege diff (module III; empty unless include_drift is true). Cross-origin false positives are reconciled away — `kind` is unexpected_access or unused_grant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--drift))
- `edges` (Attributes List) The access edges (R/RW map). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--edges))

<a id="nestedatt--drift"></a>
### Nested Schema for `drift`

Read-Only:

- `confidence` (String) attributed | approximate.
- `first_seen` (String) First-seen timestamp.
- `id` (String) Access edge id.
- `kind` (String) unexpected_access (observed, not permitted) | unused_grant (permitted, never observed).
- `last_seen` (String) Last-seen timestamp.
- `mode` (String) read | write | readwrite | unknown.
- `observed` (Boolean) Whether the edge was observed in telemetry.
- `occurrence_count` (Number) How many times the access was observed.
- `origin_id` (String) Resolved origin id.
- `origin_kind` (String) agent | identity | session.
- `permitted` (Boolean) Whether the edge is declared/permitted.
- `reconciliation_pending` (Boolean) True when an unexpected access cannot yet be proven permitted because the agent↔identity link is unresolved — honest uncertainty, not a firm violation.
- `resource_id` (String) Resolved resource id.
- `signal_source` (String) The collector that produced the edge.


<a id="nestedatt--edges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `edges`

Read-Only:

- `confidence` (String) attributed | approximate.
- `first_seen` (String) First-seen timestamp.
- `id` (String) Access edge id.
- `last_seen` (String) Last-seen timestamp.
- `mode` (String) read | write | readwrite | unknown.
- `observed` (Boolean) Whether the edge was observed in telemetry.
- `occurrence_count` (Number) How many times the access was observed.
- `origin_id` (String) Resolved origin id.
- `origin_kind` (String) agent | identity | session.
- `permitted` (Boolean) Whether the edge is declared/permitted.
- `resource_id` (String) Resolved resource id.
- `signal_source` (String) The collector that produced the edge.
